title: Complete Guide to Kubernetes Networking
title_es: Guía Completa de Networking en Kubernetes
description: Kubernetes networking manifests from the guide: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer and headless Services, NGINX Ingress with cert-manager TLS, layered NetworkPolicies, custom DNS, Istio mTLS and canary routing, plus an ordered debug workflow.
description_es: Manifiestos de networking en Kubernetes de la guía: Services ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer y headless, Ingress NGINX con TLS de cert-manager, NetworkPolicies por capas, DNS personalizado, mTLS y enrutado canary de Istio, más un flujo de depuración ordenado.
